answer: The sieve maker weaves his wires over the frame and tests each mesh with grain. Proof of sieve maker mesh via wire tally is his proof: a sieve the maker weaves only after 16 wires run even, each wire tried on the frame. The velvet is the sieve itself, true in the hand. The mirror is the fine flour that falls through it. The lagoon is the mill stream that turns the wheel. A forger must weave 16 wires even, frame the sieve and test it twice, and the grain still will not sift clean.
